title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00068 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 01:00: Removed hatches over f-15 and f-10 slots.
01:00 - 01:45: Prepared XT and TDS for lifting operation. Carried out TBT to lift XT and pull foxhole
01:45 - 03:00: Pulled foxhole to free up way for moonpool overhead crane for transporting XT
03:00 - 03:45: Pulled master bushing. Attached lifting arrangement to XT as per lifting plan
03:45 - 05:15: Removed grayloc clamp below XT block. Lifted XT to moonpool and moved to transport skid, secured same on transport skid. Meanwhile installed hatch over f-10 slot to minimize openning
05:15 - 05:45: Installed foxhole
05:45 - 07:00: Removed half moon hatches on XT deck, released NT-2 connector. Lifted NT-2 bonnet and spacer spool to rig floor. L/d same
07:00 - 09:00: Cut control lines in multibowl. Installed blank plug on exit blocks. Removed antivibration ring
09:00 - 10:15: Lowered communication collar from moonpool to multibowl. Installed communication collar. Meanwhile errect scaffolding in moonpool.
10:15 - 10:30: Performed pre-job meetingto run HP riser
10:30 - 12:15: Run HP riser, installed gasket, made up riser connection. R/d HP riser slings and recover chains to rig floor
12:15 - 13:00: Installed moonpool hatches
13:00 - 19:00: Removed protector and cleaned seal face. Installed gasket. Landed BOP onto riser. Started working with tensioners. Meanwhile pressure tested choke manifold.
19:00 - 21:00: Started to m/u NT-2 connector. Continued pressure test choke manifold
21:00 - 21:30: Installed slick joint
21:30 - 00:00: Continued to m/u NT-2 connector. Installed BOP tension system. Shifted BOP load to tension system
